Population increased in Warwickshire

The estimated population of Warwickshire in 2024 was 632,207 usual residents, a rise of 1.9% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Warwickshire increased by 5.5%.

Age profile of Warwickshire

The average (median) age fell to 42.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Warwickshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, Warwickshire's population of 632,207 usual residents was made up of:

  • 114,754 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.2%)
  • 387,345 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.3%)
  • 130,108 people aged 65 years and over, (20.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Warwickshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (20.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Warwickshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Warwickshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Warwickshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 422 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 5,757 births and 6,179 deaths in Warwickshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 9,244 (1.5%). There were 37,303 people entering the area and 28,059 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Warwickshire's population of 2,995 (0.5%) as a result of 6,057 people entering the area and 3,062 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Warwickshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Warwickshire in mid-2023 is 620,371.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,493 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 1,053 people.

In the 'other change' category (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners), we have revised the 2023 figure upwards by 2 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,548 people.
